relationships.subject: naltrexone
relationships.evidence_quote: Intraperitoneal injection of naltrexone in rats reduced highly palatable cafeteria diet intake but did not affect regular chow consumption

relationships.subject: MOR
relationships.evidence_quote: endogenous opioids, which are increased in the ARC following the consumption of various diets, inhibit AgRP neurons via MORs

key_findings: Narrative review proposing EOR-linked circuit plasticity in NAc and hypothalamus underlies both obesity and anorexia nervosa.
Obesity associated with reduced NAc MOR availability but increased hypothalamic MOR expression.
